content.json:
## Active Directory - additional visibility layer for MDI
Posture and hunting tiles that sit alongside Defender for Identity alerts. Rows 1-3 cover AD hardening signals (encryption types, NTLM fallback, edge accounts, LAPS/gMSA reads); row 4 onward tracks multi-step sequences Microsoft Threat Intelligence reported in 2026 (Storm-2570, Storm-1175, Teams IT-support impersonation, GPO-delivered ransomware). The matching Defender XDR custom detections are deployed separately. Requires MDI/MDE tables streamed to this workspace (Defender XDR connector).

content.query:
IdentityDirectoryEvents
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} and ActionType has "Encryption"
| extend AF = todynamic(AdditionalFields)
| mv-apply kv = AF on (
    extend k = tostring(bag_keys(kv)[0]), v = tostring(kv[tostring(bag_keys(kv)[0])])
    | summarize NewValue = take_anyif(v, k matches regex @"(?i)^\s*TO\b"), OldValue = take_anyif(v, k matches regex @"(?i)^\s*FROM\b")
  )
| extend NewInt = toint(NewValue)
| extend RC4WithoutAES = (isnotnull(NewInt) and binary_and(NewInt, 4) != 0 and binary_and(NewInt, 24) == 0)
    or (NewValue has "RC4" and not(NewValue has "AES"))
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, NewValue, OldValue, RC4WithoutAES), Changes = count(), ChangedBy = make_set(AccountName, 10)
    by TargetAccountUpn, TargetDeviceName
| project LastChange = TimeGenerated, TargetAccountUpn, TargetDeviceName, OldValue, NewValue, RC4WithoutAES, Changes, ChangedBy
| order by RC4WithoutAES desc, LastChange desc
content.title: Posture 11 - Encryption type changes (RC4WithoutAES = 1 is the risk)

content.query:
IdentityLogonEvents
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} and ActionType == "LogonSuccess" and Protocol in~ ("Kerberos", "Ntlm")
| summarize Logons = count() by Protocol, Day = bin(TimeGenerated, 1d)
content.title: Posture 11 - Kerberos vs NTLM successful logons

content.query:
IdentityLogonEvents
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} and ActionType == "LogonSuccess"
| where isnotempty(DestinationDeviceName) and Protocol in~ ("Kerberos", "Ntlm")
| summarize Krb = countif(Protocol =~ "Kerberos"), Ntlm = countif(Protocol =~ "Ntlm") by DestinationDeviceName, Day = bin(TimeGenerated, 1d)
| extend NtlmRatio = round(todouble(Ntlm) / (Krb + Ntlm), 2)
| order by DestinationDeviceName asc, Day asc
| extend PrevRatio = prev(NtlmRatio), PrevHost = prev(DestinationDeviceName)
| where PrevHost == DestinationDeviceName and PrevRatio < 0.1 and NtlmRatio > 0.5
| project Day, DestinationDeviceName, PrevRatio, NtlmRatio, Krb, Ntlm
content.title: Posture 3 - Services that flipped from Kerberos to NTLM

content.query:
let EdgeAccounts = split(replace_string("{EdgeAccounts}", " ", ""), ",");
union
    (IdentityQueryEvents | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} and AccountName in~ (EdgeAccounts) | extend Kind = "Query", Detail = QueryType),
    (IdentityLogonEvents | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} and AccountName in~ (EdgeAccounts) | extend Kind = "Logon", Detail = LogonType)
| summarize Events = count(), DistinctDetails = dcount(Detail), SrcIPs = make_set(IPAddress, 20) by AccountName, Kind, Day = bin(TimeGenerated, 1d)
| order by AccountName asc, Day asc
content.title: Posture 4 - Edge/VPN bind account activity

content.query:
IdentityQueryEvents
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where Query has_any ("ms-Mcs-AdmPwd", "msLAPS-Password", "msLAPS-EncryptedPassword", "msDS-ManagedPassword")
| extend Secret = case(Query has "msDS-ManagedPassword", "gMSA", "LAPS")
| summarize Reads = count(), Targets = dcount(QueryTarget), Days = dcount(bin(TimeGenerated, 1d)),
    SampleTargets = make_set(QueryTarget, 10), SourceDevices = make_set(DeviceName, 10) by AccountName, Secret
| order by Targets desc
content.title: Posture 12 - LAPS / gMSA password readers

content.query:
let Secrets = dynamic(["ms-Mcs-AdmPwd", "msLAPS-Password", "msLAPS-EncryptedPassword", "msDS-ManagedPassword"]);
let Prior = IdentityQueryEvents
    | where TimeGenerated between (ago(30d) .. ago(7d)) and Query has_any (Secrets)
    | distinct AccountName;
IdentityQueryEvents
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d) and Query has_any (Secrets)
| where AccountName !in (Prior)
| summarize FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated), Reads = count(), Targets = dcount(QueryTarget), SampleTargets = make_set(QueryTarget, 10)
    by AccountName, DeviceName
| order by Targets desc
content.title: Posture 12 - New LAPS / gMSA readers (last 7 days vs prior 23)

content.query:
let ExtraDCs = dynamic([]);   
let DCs = IdentityLogonEvents
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d) and Protocol in~ ("Kerberos", "Ntlm") and isnotempty(DestinationDeviceName)
    | summarize by Dc = tolower(tostring(split(DestinationDeviceName, ".")[0]))
    | union (print Dc = ExtraDCs | mv-expand Dc to typeof(string) | extend Dc = tolower(Dc));
let Recon = IdentityQueryEvents
    | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} and isnotempty(AccountName)
    | summarize Targets = dcount(QueryTarget) by AccountName = tolower(AccountName), Day = bin(TimeGenerated, 1d)
    | where Targets > 50
    | project TimeGenerated = Day, AccountName, Stage = "1 Recon";
let Directory = IdentityDirectoryEvents
    | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} and isnotempty(AccountName)
    | extend AF = tostring(AdditionalFields)
    | extend Stage = case(
        ActionType has "Password" and isnotempty(TargetAccountUpn) and tolower(tostring(split(TargetAccountUpn, "@")[0])) != tolower(AccountName), "2 Password reset of another account",
        ActionType == "Group Membership changed", "3 Group membership change",
        ActionType has_any ("Group Policy", "GPO", "gPLink") or AF has_any ("gPLink", "gPCFileSysPath"), "4 GPO change",
        "")
    | where isnotempty(Stage)
    | project TimeGenerated, AccountName = tolower(AccountName), Stage;
let DcLogon = DeviceLogonEvents
    | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} and LogonType in ("RemoteInteractive", "Network") and ActionType == "LogonSuccess"
    | extend ShortName = tolower(tostring(split(DeviceName, ".")[0]))
    | where ShortName in (DCs) and isnotempty(AccountName) and not(AccountName endswith "$")
    | where LogonType == "RemoteInteractive" or InitiatingProcessFileName in~ ("wsmprovhost.exe", "wmiprvse.exe", "services.exe")
    | project TimeGenerated, AccountName = tolower(AccountName), Stage = "5 Remote logon to a DC";
union Recon, Directory, DcLogon
| summarize Stages = make_set(Stage), StageCount = dcount(Stage), FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated), Events = count()
    by AccountName, Week = bin(TimeGenerated, 7d)
| where StageCount >= 3
| order by StageCount desc, LastSeen desc
content.title: Sequence - Accounts progressing through 3+ AD attack stages per week

content.query:
let ExtraDCs = dynamic([]);   
let RmmTools = dynamic(["meshagent", "meshcentral", "atera", "splashtop", "ninjarmm", "screenconnect", "anydesk",
    "simplehelp", "remote access.exe", "level.exe", "dwagent", "remotely", "cloudflared", "ngrok", "tacticalrmm", "rustdesk"]);
let Tier0 = IdentityLogonEvents
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d) and Protocol in~ ("Kerberos", "Ntlm") and isnotempty(DestinationDeviceName)
    | summarize by Host = tolower(tostring(split(DestinationDeviceName, ".")[0]))
    | union (print Host = ExtraDCs | mv-expand Host to typeof(string) | extend Host = tolower(Host))
    | union (DeviceProcessEvents | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} and FileName =~ "miiserver.exe"
        | summarize by Host = tolower(tostring(split(DeviceName, ".")[0])));
DeviceProcessEvents
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| extend Host = tolower(tostring(split(DeviceName, ".")[0]))
| where Host in (Tier0)
| where FileName has_any (RmmTools) or ProcessCommandLine has_any (RmmTools)
| summarize FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated), Executions = count(), Accounts = make_set(AccountName, 5),
    SampleCommandLine = take_any(ProcessCommandLine) by DeviceName, FileName
| order by FirstSeen desc
content.title: Sequence 13 - RMM / tunnel tools on DCs and Entra Connect

content.query:
let PrivilegedGroups = dynamic(["Domain Admins", "Enterprise Admins", "Schema Admins", "Administrators",
    "Account Operators", "Backup Operators", "Server Operators", "Print Operators", "DnsAdmins", "Group Policy Creator Owners"]);
let Privileged = IdentityInfo
    | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} and isnotempty(AccountUpn)
    | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, CriticalityLevel, Tags, GroupMembership) by AccountUpn
    | where CriticalityLevel > 0 or tostring(Tags) has_any ("Sensitive", "Admin", "Privileged")
        or tostring(GroupMembership) has_any (PrivilegedGroups)
    | project VictimUpn = tolower(AccountUpn);
IdentityDirectoryEvents
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where ActionType has "Password" and ActionType has_any ("reset", "changed")
| where isnotempty(TargetAccountUpn) and isnotempty(AccountName)
| extend VictimUpn = tolower(TargetAccountUpn)
| where tolower(AccountName) != tolower(tostring(split(VictimUpn, "@")[0]))
| join kind=inner Privileged on VictimUpn
| summarize Resets = count(), DistinctTargets = dcount(VictimUpn), Targets = make_set(VictimUpn, 20),
    SourceDevices = make_set(DeviceName, 10), LastReset = max(TimeGenerated) by ResetBy = AccountName, AccountDomain
| order by DistinctTargets desc, LastReset desc
content.title: Sequence 16 - Privileged password resets by actor

content.query:
let ExtraDCs = dynamic([]);   
let Tier0 = IdentityLogonEvents
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d) and Protocol in~ ("Kerberos", "Ntlm") and isnotempty(DestinationDeviceName)
    | summarize by Host = tolower(tostring(split(DestinationDeviceName, ".")[0]))
    | union (print Host = ExtraDCs | mv-expand Host to typeof(string) | extend Host = tolower(Host))
    | union (DeviceProcessEvents | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} and FileName =~ "miiserver.exe"
        | summarize by Host = tolower(tostring(split(DeviceName, ".")[0])));
DeviceNetworkEvents
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where ActionType == "InboundConnectionAccepted" and LocalPort in (5985, 5986, 3389)
| extend Host = tolower(tostring(split(DeviceName, ".")[0]))
| where Host in (Tier0)
| extend Service = case(LocalPort in (5985, 5986), "WinRM", "RDP")
| summarize Sessions = count(), FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated), Targets = make_set(DeviceName, 10)
    by SourceIP = RemoteIP, Service
| order by FirstSeen desc
content.title: Sequences 17/19 - Inbound WinRM/RDP to Tier 0 by source
